label: VERIFIED
extraction: Cursor TypeScript SDK (@cursor/sdk) lets you call Cursor's agent from your own TypeScript code. Same agent runs in Cursor IDE, CLI, and web app. SDK Bridge is a local server embedding TypeScript SDK exposing agent surface over Connect/protobuf protocol for languages without first-party SDK. MCP servers, subagents, and hooks resolve from inline options > creation-time inline > project files > user files > team/dashboard config. Per-send mcpServers fully replaces creation-time servers. settingSources controls which config layers load: user, project, local, plugins. additionalDirectories (TypeScript) / add_dirs (Python) pass --add-dir to Claude Code. Skills, commands, subagents from flag-added directories load through project setting source.
